text: ５にんで　きのみを　つづけてとった　かいすう

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きのみを　つづけてとった　かいすう
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase right before a noun describes it. きのみを　つづけてとった　かいすう = 'the number of times berries were picked in a row'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a number of people says the group doing it. ５にんで = 'with 5 people'.
